title: T6: Amend the review policy with an observation-to-disposition gate
description:
AUDIT REFERENCE: finding F6 and section 10.2.

PROBLEM
docs/design-and-pr-review-policy.md is individually sound but composes into an
accretion loop, because THE DISPOSITION GATE IS ASYMMETRIC. "Findings
discipline" requires every valid finding be repaired in the current PR;
"Review the mechanism" requires each defect be generalized, sibling-searched,
varied across state dimensions, and given permanent regression evidence. The
only escape is permanent rejection, which uniquely requires "recorded
reasoning that explains why the governing invariant and authority require no
change."

Accepting a finding therefore costs nothing extra; rejecting one costs work.
When accepting is cheaper than rejecting, a sufficiently capable reviewer
accepts by default -- and each acceptance mandates generalized repair plus
permanent evidence plus a widened sibling search, enlarging the surface the
next review examines.

MEASURED SIGNATURE
1,103 beads; 100 named "Dispatch:"; a 15-round rev chain on eshyra-jhpt; and
an attempt distribution of 45 tasks at attempt 1 but 4 reaching attempt 6, 2
attempt 7, 2 attempt 8, 2 attempt 9. The policy already says a defect class
surviving two repair cycles warrants a fresh full review; attempt-9 tasks show
that escape hatch is not firing.

REQUIRED WORK
Add an explicit observation -> disposition -> finding pipeline AHEAD of
"Findings discipline", and make the two paths symmetrically cheap. Proposed
text is in audit section 10.2. Load-bearing clauses:

- A technically correct observation is not a finding. Before publishing one,
  record: the governing invariant; the authority for it; the ownership and
  consumer boundary; applicability or reachability where material; the actual
  consequence of violation; the proportionate closure condition; and the
  proportionate permanent evidence.
- An observation that cannot name an operative authority and a real producer
  or consumer is dispositioned as "no requirement", IN ONE LINE, and is not a
  finding. THIS MUST COST NO MORE THAN ACCEPTING IT. "We could make this more
  defensive" is not "the system requires this defense."
- A finding must state whether its permanent evidence is a generalized
  invariant or an exact reproducer, and why that choice is proportionate.
- Reachability is a first-class disposition axis. A defect on a path no
  producer or consumer reaches is dispositioned at its real severity.

Also make the two-cycle rule mechanical: a THIRD dispatch on the same defect
class REQUIRES a fresh full review of the subsystem.

MUST NOT CHANGE
Sibling search, state-dimension variation, proof-mechanism review, and the ban
on nonblocking/follow-up/deferred labels. Those produce genuine defect
discovery. The amendment targets ONLY the disposition gate. Do not weaken
"every valid finding blocks approval" -- the failure is upstream of it.

ACCEPTANCE
- The pipeline is stated before "Findings discipline" and the one-line
  rejection path is explicit and demonstrably no more costly than acceptance.
- The two-cycle escalation is mechanical.
- No review contract, hash, checkpoint, certification, or other artifact is
  introduced; the policy's existing prohibition on such ceremony holds.

EXCLUSIONS
Documentation only.
notes:
PR #553 (branch eshyra-9l5s-policy-path). Stays in_progress until that PR merges.
SCOPE AND WORDING AMENDED 2026-09-15 (PR #553 review, head ade2cdc5).

1. SCOPE. 'EXCLUSIONS: Documentation only.' superseded on the same grounds as eshyra-9l5s.3: docs/design-and-pr-review-policy.md is already guarded by reviewLifecyclePolicy.test.ts, and this bead's change to the two-cycle clause breaks an existing assertion there. Authorized: updating invalidated assertions and adding guards for the new section, in that existing file only. Still not authorized: any new test file, checker, script, or required artifact.

Disposition of the two added guards under eshyra-9l5s.3's standard:
- 'gates observations on disposition before they become findings' — pins the gate and its cost-symmetry clause, the mechanism that keeps acceptance from being the cheaper default.
- 'keeps the defect-finding search undiminished by the disposition gate' — the highest-value of the three. Without it, a later edit could quietly turn a convergence mechanism into a defect-hiding one. Sibling search, state-dimension variation, and proof-mechanism review must stay required.
Both are document-text assertions costing ~1 ms and gating repo-wide review behavior.

2. WORDING NARROWED. This bead previously mandated that an observation unable to name an operative authority AND A REAL PRODUCER OR CONSUMER be dispositioned 'no requirement'. That is overstrong and is withdrawn.

It made present reachability a prerequisite for a requirement EXISTING, which:
- exceeds docs/design-and-pr-review-policy.md, which requires real consumers 'where applicable', not universally;
- contradicts the next paragraph of this bead's own policy text, which correctly says an unreached path is not thereby safe or absent;
- breaks staged work, where an accepted ADR or owning Bead legitimately requires an implementation before its consumer is integrated; and
- would have auto-dispositioned away the audit's own F3 analysis of the discovery subsystem, which has real authority and no current production caller.

REPLACEMENT, now implemented: the one-line 'no requirement' disposition turns on failure to name an operative INVARIANT AND ITS AUTHORITY. Producers, consumers, and reachability are weighed at the existing applicability/consequence steps 'where material', and shape severity, closure condition, and proof burden - never admission.
PR #553 review at head ade2cdc5: CHANGES REQUESTED, 2 blockers, both repaired at head d5ce69b2. See the scope/wording amendment notes above.
